messages:
kevin: Deploy-bot just paused the eu-west canary for payments-api. It hit the batch window grace threshold and the chart-lock check failed :grimacing:
deploy-bot: Canary paused by auto-policy: batch_window_grace_exceeded=120s; chart_lock=present; reason=postupgrade-hook-failure on pod payments-api-worker-7f9
maria: Ugh. Which postupgrade hook failed? Any logs? :eyes:
ajordan: I saw a 502 from the worker postupgrade job followed by a SIGTERM during image pullbackoff. Possibly sidecar init ordering?
ashley: Chart is 2.14.0 -> 2.15.0 in this promotion. Sidecar image changed from envoy:1.23 to envoy:1.25 in the subchart. Could be ordering or init container timeout.
kevin: Can we pin the chart version for eu-west to 2.14.0 while we investigate? We need to avoid global rollback if it's regional.
release-manager: Suggestion: manual pin at the release controller level for eu-west only, then assemble release notes about the hotfix. Anyone opposed?
maria: OK with pin, but this thread should also capture the rollback criteria in case we need to roll forward vs rollback.
ajordan: If error rate > 2% for 5m and SLO error budget depleted, we should rollback chart to 2.14.0 across regions unless we can isolate to eu-west.
kevin: I'm going to run the promote-lock command to pin the previous chart in eu-west. Command: `rbctl lock --region eu-west-1 --chart payments-api=2.14.0 --reason "postupgrade-hook-failure"`
ashley: FYI you might need to annotate the values override to keep the new feature flag on for other regions: add `values.pilot=true` to the override.
kevin: Ran lock command, deploy-bot confirmed: chart lock set for eu-west-1 payments-api=2.14.0 :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Note: canary remains paused. Manual rollback required to resume traffic if policy demands.
maria: I'll grab logs and run a repro in staging for the postupgrade hook. Putting links in release notes draft: https://ci.internal/logs/4567 and https://prow.internal/job/payments-upgrade/123
release-manager: For release notes, add section: "eu-west canary held due to post-upgrade hook failure; chart pinned to 2.14.0 for stability; follow-up fix targeting sidecar init ordering in 2.15.1"
ajordan: Also create a ticket to revert the chart lock after the fix is validated: RM-4589. Add owners: @maria and @ashley.
kevin: Agreed. If staging repro fails, we will roll back across regions. For now, keep eu-west pinned and continue promotion elsewhere.
ashley: I'll prepare a minimal diff patch for 2.15.1 to try adjusting init container timeouts and add a short integration test for the hook.
maria: Will also add an eval prompt set to validate worker boot sequence and hook completion times.
release-manager: Summary action items: 1) chart pin in eu-west (done), 2) draft release note entry (in progress), 3) RM-4589 created for unpin + fix (assign maria, ashley), 4) monitor canary health for 30m then reconvene.
kevin: Thanks everyone. If monitoring spikes please escalate in #eng-oncall. I'll update the release notes and tag @product for visibility. :memo:
